recipes.name: Harry Potter Special
ingredients: 2 1/2 sticks of semi frozen unsalted butter
2 1/2 sticks of semi frozen unsalted butter
instructions: For Pumpkin Pastry:
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Cut pumpkins in half and scoop the seeds out. - 2 sugar pie pumpkins
Place the pumpkin halves pumpkin side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and place in the oven for 30-40 minutes.
Puree ¾ of the roasted pumpkin.

To the roasted pumpkin, add heavy cream, nutmeg, ground cloves, cinnamon, a pinch of allspice, vanilla paste, brown sugar, maple syrup, large egg and kosher salt, and mix well in food processor till smooth. - ½ cup heavy cream - pinch nutmeg - 1 tsp cinnamon - pinch allspice - 1 tsp vanilla paste. - ½ cup brown sugar - ¼ cup maple syrup - 1 large egg
For The Crust and Assembly
Mix the water and the vodka together in small bowl and place in freezer until it’s almost frozen. - ¼ cup water - ¼ cup vodka
Place your flour into the food processor with an sugar and salt. - 7 ½ ounces all purpose flour - 1 ounce sugar - 1 tsp kosher salt
Pulse to combine before adding semi-frozen unsalted butter. - 2 ½ sticks of semi frozen unsalted butter
Process for 10 seconds or until it's a pebbly texture.
Transfer to a large mixing bowl and fold in water/vodka mixture a couple of tablespoons at a time.
Then add the rest of the flour and water/vodka mixture and continue to fold until mixture becomes a shaggy dough. - 3 ¾ ounces all purpose flour
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for an hour or more.
After it has rested, roll out the dough and cut it into 4-inch rounds.
Brush one edge with beaten egg yolk and fill the center with a tablespoon or two of pumpkin pie filling.
Fold the dough over and crimp shut with a fork.
Brush with egg yolk and sprinkle with granulated sugar.
Bake in 400° F oven for 20-30 minutes.
For Treacle Tart:
For The Crust
Follow steps of the pie crust above. - ¼ cup water - ¼ cup vodka - 11 ½ ounces all purpose flour - 1 ounce sugar - 1 tsp kosher salt - 2 ½ sticks of semi frozen unsalted butter
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for an hour or more.
After it has rested, roll out enough dough to cover the bottom half of a 12 inch removable bottom tart pan.
Roll dough around rolling pin and unfurl it on top of the tart pan. Lift the dough and press down to get it in all the corners.
Trim the excess and press into the sides of the pan. Poke some holes in the bottom with a fork, and gently line with alumnim foil.
Use a pie weight (I used cornmeal) to go on top of the foil and blind bake 15 minutes in an oven at 400°F.
For The Filling:
Take light molasses and combine with butter on a low heat just until the butter melts in a saucepan. - 16 ounces light molasses - 2 tbsp butter
Add heavy cream and whisk rigorously until the mixture cools slightly, just enough to not cook an egg. Then beat in bread crumbs and large egg. - 3 tbsp heavy cream - ¼ cup bread crumbs - 1 large egg
Add filling to baked tart crust and place in a 350°F oven for 45-50 minutes.
Allow to cool completely.
Top with whipped cream.
Serve and enjoy!
For Butterbeer:

Combine egg white, butterscotch schnapps, heavy cream, vanilla extract, simple syrup, and ice into a shaker. - 1 egg white - 2 ounces butterscotch schnapps - 1 ounce heavy cream - 1 pinch vanilla extract - ½ ounces simple syrup - Ice
Shake until frothy.
Add half of mixture to a glass with some cream soda. - Cream soda
Serve and enjoy!
